name: Blow Over
body:
When your anger blows over, you’re no longer scary.

Prerequisite(s): Persuasive (feat) or natural comedian and quackitude racial characteristic

Benefit(s): When you use Intimidate to influence an opponent’s attitude, you can limit the duration to 1d6 + 4 minutes. If you do, the target’s reaction to you does not change to unfriendly after the duration expires. Intimidation is always a class skill for you.
